I have held off on releasing the credit hold on C-2207 (Pellham Industrial) because Priya Shah instructed me at 9:00 to place the account on hold due to three overdue invoices totaling $41,600.00 (oldest at 61 days). 

Since I report to both of you and have received conflicting instructions, I have sent a message to both you and Priya so you can align on how to proceed. Please let me know once a decision is made and I will update the account immediately.
